'''Lopers''' were the largest [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[burrower]] found on [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]. They were carnivorous pack hunters, armed with teeth and claws, and a bone-plated barbed tail. They would not live or breed in captivity, and their luxurious [[Color/Legends|red]] fur was highly sought after by the wealthy for use in clothing.
